answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ—the most material current problem. Memory_91 shows activation messaging directly improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action. Memory_86 shows onboarding shortening lifted adoption. Verification of memory_31 (signup simplification) and memory_91 (activation messaging) will confirm which lever—onboarding friction vs. in-product momentum—is most reliable. Activation messaging is lower-risk than promotional pricing (which could harm long-term unit economics and doesn't address the engagement decline directly) and more focused than enterprise sales assist (which is orthogonal to the current SMB/self-serve activation problem). Referral incentives depend on existing customer quality; with activation down, we risk amplifying weak cohorts. A standard experiment on activation messaging can run this week, measure first-week engagement lift within 7–10 days, and preserve optionality for pricing tactics if needed next week.
